job: Read a research paper in full: its contents, figures, notes, references and how to cite it.
purpose: A paper as an fd-site-article aside: breadcrumb, title, authors with affiliations, actions; a sticky rail (contents that follow the reader, key facts, the PDF) that becomes a disclosure below desktop; the abstract and numbered sections at reading size, a table and a chart with captions and sources, a data and method callout, then notes with back links, references with a hanging indent, Cite this and the licence.
useWhen: Research read in full on the page.
Readers need to cite it and follow its notes and references.

avoidWhen.when: A report sold on its findings, with a gated PDF.

sections.why: Shared with the customer story and the changelog: the editorial pages.
The contents rail beside numbered sections; figures and tables break out to the column's end; notes and references at the foot.
A paper ends with its references; the footer stays one quiet row.
